channel.title: Reza Larimi, writing
channel.description: Occasional pieces by Reza Larimi on intelligence, hardware, founders and what he is learning.

item.title: 4 Questions That Show You Your Strengths (and Your Team’s)
item.dc:creator: Reza Larimi
item.description: Gallup found only 20% of employees feel their strengths are in play every day. Four simple questions to find your strengths, and your team’s: what comes naturally, what people compliment, what is easy for you but hard for others, and when you feel most like yourself.

item.title: How Talent Becomes a Strength
item.dc:creator: Reza Larimi
item.description: Interest, passion, talent and the investment that turns potential into reliable performance. A short reflection on Tom Rath’s StrengthsFinder 2.0, with a practical exercise.

item.title: Super Smoothie: Seven Jars, Five-Minute Mornings
item.dc:creator: Reza Larimi
item.description: My personal smoothie routine: seven jars prepared ahead, ingredients and amounts for one smoothie, plus the rest of my day. By Reza Larimi.

item.title: A Kind No: Four Questions Before the Next Yes
item.dc:creator: Reza Larimi
item.description: You can care about people and still hold a hard standard. A one-minute check before the next yes: purpose, capacity, ownership, trade-off. Prompted by a Harvard Business Review piece on purpose-driven leadership.

item.title: Life Has No Stop Button: One Perspective on the AI Moment
item.dc:creator: Reza Larimi
item.description: AI is not artificial. It is evolution finding a new substrate. One perspective on the superintelligence moment, without telling you how to feel about it.
